# Netflix+GPT

> A Netflix-style movie browsing app with AI-powered movie recommendations, built as a personal/learning project.

Netflix+GPT lets signed-in users browse trending, popular, top-rated, and upcoming movies sourced from The Movie Database (TMDB), watch trailers, view detailed movie pages (cast, rating, similar titles), and get natural-language movie recommendations powered by an LLM (OpenAI GPT). Authentication is handled by Firebase.

## Pages

- [Sign In / Sign Up](https://netflix-gpt-ten-alpha.vercel.app/): the only page reachable without an account; everything else requires signing in first.

## Notes

- This is a demo/learning project, not a commercial streaming service — it does not host or stream any licensed video content, only publicly available YouTube trailers.
- Movie data, posters, and trailers are sourced from the TMDB API and are TMDB's/its providers' content, not original to this site.
- The `/browse` area and movie detail pages require authentication and are excluded from crawling (see robots.txt); their content is per-user TMDB data, not unique editorial content.
